description: This file contains the implementation of the HTTP/1.x protocol layer for the server, including functions for sending responses, handling headers, parsing request headers, managing request bodies (including chunked transfer encoding), and connection timeout handling. It defines core request processing logic related to HTTP/1.1 communication.

methods.name: int h1_send_1xx_info(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Sends HTTP/1.1 1xx interim responses, manages partial writes, and updates connection states.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_send_1xx(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Constructs and sends the HTTP/1.1 1xx response headers, invoking h1_send_1xx_info as needed.

methods.name: int h1_send_100_continue(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Sends the HTTP/1.1 100 Continue response if client expects it.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void h1_send_headers_partial_1xx(request_st * const r,buffer * const b)
methods.description: Transfers partial header data from the connection's write queue into a buffer for sending.

methods.name: void h1_send_headers(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Prepares and sends HTTP response headers, managing connection headers like keep-alive and handling special cases such as 304 responses.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ chunk * h1_discard_blank_line(chunkqueue * const cq,uint32_t header_len)
methods.description: Discard a blank line in headers, used during header parsing.

methods.name: chunk * h1_recv_headers_more(connection * const con,chunkqueue * const cq,chunk * c,const size_t olen)
methods.description: Reads additional header data from the connection, handling partial reads and HTTP/2 detection.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_upgrade(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Checks and handles HTTP Upgrade headers for protocols like websocket or HTTP/2.

methods.name: int h1_recv_headers(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Reads and parses request headers, including handling pipelined requests, oversized headers, and protocol validation.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_expect_100(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Checks if the request has an Expect: 100-continue header and sends the response if appropriate.

methods.name: int h1_cq_compact(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Optimizes the chunkqueue by merging adjacent memory chunks.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int h1_chunked_crlf(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Checks for proper CRLF at the end of chunked transfer encoding data.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_400_bad_request(request_st * const r,const char * errstr)
methods.description: Logs an error and returns a 400 status code for malformed chunked requests.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_trailers(request_st * const restrict r,char * restrict t,uint32_t tlen)
methods.description: Processes HTTP chunked transfer trailers, validates them, and updates request headers accordingly.

methods.name: int h1_chunked(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Handles parsing and processing of chunked transfer encoding request bodies, including trailer handling and size validation.

methods.name: int h1_read_body_unknown(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Reads request body data when content length is unknown, with size limit enforcement.

methods.name: handler_t h1_reqbody_read(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Main function for reading and processing request bodies, supporting chunked and fixed-length bodies and handling streaming requests.

methods.name: int h1_check_timeout(connection * const con,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Checks connection for read/write timeouts, handling various states including keep-alive, error, and close.
